description: Use this when the user wants the full results (the pizarra: 20 numbers) of a quiniela or a turno: 'pizarra de la nocturna', 'los 20 números de la Provincia', 'quiniela de Córdoba vespertina de ayer'. Returns all 20 positions, the cabeza, the draw number and the letters. Filter by jurisdiction (ciudad, provincia, cordoba, santafe, entrerios, montevideo, mendoza, chaco, corrientes, neuquen, jujuy, chubut), by turno (previa (10:15), primera (12:00), matutina (15:00), vespertina (18:00), nocturna (21:00)) or both; at least one is required. When the host shows the result as a widget, the user already sees every number: do not repeat them in a table or list, answer in one or two sentences (what is still pending, or what stands out).

date.description: Draw day in Argentina: YYYY-MM-DD, "today" or "yesterday". Omit for the latest results.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction key, slug or name, e.g. ciudad, provincia, santa-fe, Córdoba.

turno.description: Turno key: previa, primera, matutina, vespertina or nocturna.
